LanguageData.DMS_PirateAssemblySite.label: pirate assembly yard
LanguageData.DMS_PirateAssemblySite.description: An old automatroid assembly yard, seized by pirates and put back into service. The machines coming off the line are their own.
LanguageData.DMS_PirateAssemblySite.arrivedLetter: You have arrived at the pirate assembly yard.\n\nOnce the crew raise the alarm, enemy reinforcements will begin to arrive.
